## ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

"**Disclosure Letter**" means the letter from the Sellers to the Purchaser dated the Signing Date disclosing exceptions to the Warranties, together with the Disclosure Bundle attached thereto.

"**Escrow Account**" means the escrow account established pursuant to the Escrow Agreement.

"**Relevant Period**" means the period of [two / three] years prior to the Signing Date.

"**Restricted Activities**" has the meaning given in Clause 12.2.

"**Restricted Period**" means the period of [24 / 36] months commencing on the Completion Date.

"**Rollover Shares**" means [●] ordinary shares in the capital of the Purchaser (or its designated Affiliate) to be issued to [specified Sellers] in lieu of cash Consideration as set out in the Rollover Agreement.

"**Sale Shares**" means [●] ordinary shares of [£0.001 / €0.01] each in the capital of the Company as further particularised in Schedule 1.

"**Sellers' Representative**" means [Seller 1 / [●]] appointed pursuant to Clause 16.1.

"**Subsidiary**" has the meaning given to it in section 1159 of the Companies Act 2006.

"**Title Warranties**" means the Warranties set out in paragraphs [1 to 3] of Schedule 5.

"**Transaction**" means the acquisition of the Sale Shares by the Purchaser on the terms of this Agreement and all related transactions contemplated herein.

"**TUPE**" means the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006 (SI 2006/246) and any equivalent legislation in any other jurisdiction.

"**Warranty**" means each of the representations and warranties of the Sellers set out in Schedule 5, and "**Warranties**" means all of them.

### 1.2 Interpretation

## ARTICLE II — SALE AND PURCHASE

### 2.1 Agreement to Sell and Purchase

Subject to the satisfaction (or waiver, where permitted) of the Conditions set out in Article IV, each Seller hereby agrees to sell, and the Purchaser hereby agrees to purchase, with full title guarantee, the Sale Shares set out opposite that Seller's name in Schedule 1, free from all Encumbrances and together with all rights attaching to them as at the Completion Date (including all dividends and distributions declared, made, or paid after the Locked-Box Date [/ Completion Date]).

### 2.2 Entire Issued Share Capital

The Parties acknowledge that the Sale Shares, in aggregate, represent [●]% of the issued and outstanding share capital of the Company on a fully diluted basis. A breakdown of the Company's fully diluted share capital is set out in Schedule 1.

### 2.3 No Obligation to Complete Separately

The Purchaser shall not be obliged to complete the purchase of any of the Sale Shares unless the purchase of all of the Sale Shares is completed simultaneously.

### 2.4 Waiver of Pre-emption Rights

Each Seller hereby irrevocably waives, and shall procure the waiver of, any and all pre-emption rights, rights of first refusal, drag-along obligations, tag-along entitlements, and any other rights or restrictions affecting the transfer of the Sale Shares that would otherwise be triggered by or applicable to the Transaction, whether arising under the Company's articles of association, any shareholders' agreement, or otherwise.

---

## ARTICLE III — CONSIDERATION

### 3.1 Total Consideration

The aggregate consideration payable by the Purchaser to the Sellers for the Sale Shares (the "**Consideration**") shall be:

(a) an amount equal to the Enterprise Value; **plus**

(b) Cash of the Group as at the Locked-Box Date [/ Completion Date]; **less**

(c) Net Debt of the Group as at the Locked-Box Date [/ Completion Date]; **plus or minus**

(d) the Working Capital Adjustment (if any) as determined under Schedule 6; **less**

(e) the aggregate amount of any Leakage (excluding Permitted Leakage) occurring between the Locked-Box Date and Completion; **plus**

(f) the Earn-Out Consideration (if any) payable pursuant to Clause 3.4,

subject always to adjustment in accordance with this Article III.

### 3.2 Completion Payment

On or prior to Completion, the Purchaser shall pay to the Sellers (in the proportions set out in the Consideration Allocation Schedule in Schedule 1A):

(a) an amount equal to the Estimated Consideration (as defined in Clause 3.6), **less** the Escrow Amount (the "**Completion Payment**"), in immediately available funds by electronic transfer to the bank accounts notified to the Purchaser in writing by the Sellers' Representative not less than [five (5)] Business Days prior to the Completion Date; **and**

(b) the Escrow Amount, by transfer to the Escrow Account on the terms of the Escrow Agreement.

### 3.3 Consideration Shares

[Where applicable:] In lieu of [●]% of the cash Consideration otherwise payable to [Seller 1 / specified Sellers], the Purchaser shall (or shall procure that its designated Affiliate shall) issue the Consideration Shares to [●] on Completion, credited as fully paid and ranking pari passu in all respects with existing ordinary shares in [ACQUIRER PARENT PLC]. The Consideration Shares shall be issued pursuant to, and subject to the terms of, the Lock-Up Deed attached as **Schedule 14** (*Lock-Up Deed*).

### 3.4 Earn-Out Consideration

(a) In addition to the Completion Payment, the Purchaser shall pay to the Sellers additional consideration (the "**Earn-Out Consideration**") if the Group achieves the performance targets set out in Schedule 15 (*Earn-Out Schedule*) during the Earn-Out Period.

(b) The Earn-Out Consideration shall be calculated in accordance with, and subject to the accounting policies and definitions set out in, Schedule 15.

(c) The Purchaser shall (and shall procure that the Group shall) operate the Business during the Earn-Out Period in good faith and shall not take any action (or procure any action to be taken) the primary purpose of which is to depress, reduce, or otherwise manipulate the financial performance of the Group during the Earn-Out Period in a manner adverse to the Sellers' entitlement to Earn-Out Consideration.

(d) Within [60] days of the end of the Earn-Out Period, the Purchaser shall deliver to the Sellers' Representative a written statement calculating the Earn-Out Consideration (the "**Earn-Out Statement**"), including all supporting workings. The Sellers' Representative shall have [30] days to review and raise any objections in writing; any disputes shall be resolved pursuant to the Expert Determination procedure in Schedule 6.

### 3.5 Purchase Price Adjustment — Working Capital and Net Debt

(a) The Consideration shall be subject to adjustment after Completion in respect of Working Capital and Net Debt in accordance with Schedule 6 (*Completion Accounts Procedure*) (the "**Purchase Price Adjustment**").

(b) If the Completion Accounts show that the Working Capital is below the Normalised Working Capital by more than £[●] (the "**Working Capital Threshold**"), the Consideration shall be reduced pound-for-pound by the amount of such shortfall.

(c) If the Completion Accounts show that the Working Capital exceeds the Normalised Working Capital by more than the Working Capital Threshold, the Consideration shall be increased pound-for-pound by the amount of such excess.

(d) Any net adjustment in favour of the Purchaser shall first be met from the Escrow Account, with any residual balance payable by the Sellers pro rata to their respective Sale Share holdings within [10] Business Days of final determination. Any net adjustment in favour of the Sellers shall be paid by the Purchaser within [10] Business Days of final determination.

### 3.6 Estimated Completion Statement

Not less than [five (5)] Business Days prior to the Completion Date, the Sellers' Representative shall deliver to the Purchaser a statement (the "**Estimated Completion Statement**") setting out the Sellers' good-faith estimate of (i) Cash; (ii) Debt; (iii) Working Capital; and (iv) Leakage as at the Completion Date, together with reasonable supporting documentation, and from which an estimated Consideration (the "**Estimated Consideration**") shall be derived.

### 3.7 Allocation Among Sellers

The Consideration shall be allocated among the Sellers in the proportions set out in Schedule 1A (*Consideration Allocation Schedule*). The Purchaser shall have no responsibility for ensuring that Consideration is applied or distributed among the Sellers in accordance with any agreement among them; such allocation is solely the responsibility of the Sellers.

### 3.8 Withholding Tax

(a) All payments of Consideration are expressed exclusive of any withholding or deduction required by applicable law. If any Seller is required to withhold or deduct any amount from a Consideration payment, that Seller shall promptly notify the Purchaser and shall cooperate with the Purchaser to seek a reduction or exemption.

(b) The Purchaser shall be entitled to withhold from any amount payable under this Agreement any withholding Tax that it is required by applicable law to withhold and shall remit such amount to the relevant Tax Authority. If the Purchaser withholds any amount, it shall provide the relevant Seller with a receipt or other evidence of such withholding within [10] Business Days of the relevant payment to the Tax Authority.

## ARTICLE IV — CONDITIONS PRECEDENT

### 4.1 Conditions

Completion is conditional upon the satisfaction (or waiver in accordance with Clause 4.3) of the following conditions (the "**Conditions**"):

(a) **Sellers' Board / Shareholder Approval**: the board of directors of the Company (and, where required, its shareholders) shall have passed all resolutions necessary to approve the Transaction and give effect to Completion, including (without limitation) the approval of any change-of-control arrangements and the convening of any extraordinary general meeting;

(b) **Regulatory Clearances**: receipt of all merger control, foreign investment, financial regulatory, and other governmental approvals and clearances listed in **Schedule 2** (*Required Regulatory Approvals*) (the "**Regulatory Condition**"), each on terms and conditions acceptable to the Purchaser (acting reasonably);

(c) **Third-Party Consents**: receipt of all material third-party consents identified in **Schedule 3** (*Required Third-Party Consents*), including without limitation consents from: (i) the Company's principal banking group under its existing facilities agreement; (ii) each counterparty to a material contract containing a change-of-control clause; and (iii) the landlord(s) under the Group's key property leases, each on terms and conditions acceptable to the Purchaser (acting reasonably);

(d) **No MAE**: no Material Adverse Effect shall have occurred or be subsisting between the Signing Date and the Completion Date;

(e) **Warranties True and Accurate**: the Warranties shall be true and accurate in all material respects (and, in the case of the Fundamental Warranties and Title Warranties, in all respects) as at the Signing Date and as at the Completion Date (as if made on and as of the Completion Date), save to the extent that any inaccuracy or breach has been cured to the Purchaser's reasonable satisfaction;

(f) **Pre-Completion Obligations**: all Pre-Completion Conduct Obligations set out in Clause 7 shall have been complied with in all material respects;

(g) **Key Person Retention**: each of the Key Persons identified in **Schedule 16** (*Key Persons*) shall remain employed by or engaged with the Group and shall have entered into the employment agreement / service agreement in the form attached as **Schedule 17** (*Key Person Employment Terms*) on terms acceptable to the Purchaser; and

(h) **[W&I Insurance]**: [the W&I Insurance Policy shall have been placed and shall be in full force and effect on terms no less favourable than the indicative terms disclosed to the Sellers].

### 4.2 Responsibility for Satisfaction of Conditions

(a) Each Party shall use all reasonable endeavours to procure the satisfaction of the Conditions as soon as reasonably practicable and in any event prior to the Long-Stop Date.

(b) The Purchaser shall be responsible (at its own cost) for making all filings required to obtain the Regulatory Condition and shall keep the Sellers' Representative reasonably informed of the status of all regulatory proceedings.

(c) The Sellers shall use all reasonable endeavours to obtain all Third-Party Consents and shall provide all cooperation reasonably requested by the Purchaser in connection therewith.

(d) Each Party shall promptly notify the other Parties if it becomes aware of any circumstance that would, or would reasonably be expected to, prevent or materially delay the satisfaction of any Condition.

### 4.3 Waiver of Conditions

(a) The Conditions in Clauses 4.1(a), 4.1(d), 4.1(e), and 4.1(f) may be waived only by the Purchaser (in its absolute discretion) in writing.

(b) The Condition in Clause 4.1(b) (Regulatory Clearances) may not be waived by any Party.

(c) The Conditions in Clauses 4.1(c) (Third-Party Consents) may be waived by the mutual written agreement of the Purchaser and the Sellers' Representative.

(d) The Condition in Clause 4.1(g) (Key Person Retention) may be waived by the Purchaser (in its absolute discretion) in writing.

### 4.4 Long-Stop Date

(a) If the Conditions have not been satisfied (or waived) by the Long-Stop Date, either the Purchaser or the Sellers' Representative may (subject to Clause 4.4(b)) terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other Parties, and such termination shall be without liability to any Party (save in respect of any antecedent breach of this Agreement and the surviving provisions of Clause 17 (*Confidentiality*) and Clause 19 (*Miscellaneous*)).

(b) The right to terminate under Clause 4.4(a) shall not be available to a Party whose failure to fulfil any obligation under this Agreement has been the primary cause of the failure of the Conditions to be satisfied.

### 4.5 Break Fee

[If applicable:] In the event that this Agreement is terminated pursuant to Clause 4.4 solely as a result of the failure to obtain the Regulatory Condition, the Purchaser shall pay to the Sellers a break fee of £[●] (the "**Break Fee**") within [10] Business Days of such termination. The Break Fee shall be the Sellers' sole and exclusive remedy in such circumstances.

## ARTICLE V — COMPLETION

### 5.1 Date and Place of Completion

Subject to the satisfaction (or waiver) of the Conditions, Completion shall take place at the offices of [PURCHASER'S COUNSEL], [address], at [10:00 a.m.] on:

(a) the date falling [5] Business Days after the satisfaction (or waiver) of the last of the Conditions; or

(b) such other date as the Parties may agree in writing,

provided that Completion shall not occur later than the Long-Stop Date.

### 5.2 Sellers' Obligations at Completion

At Completion, each Seller shall deliver (or procure the delivery of) to the Purchaser the following:

(a) duly executed stock transfer form(s) in favour of the Purchaser (or its nominee) in respect of that Seller's Sale Shares, together with the original share certificate(s) therefor (or an indemnity for any lost certificates in a form acceptable to the Purchaser);

(b) a copy, certified as true and correct, of the board resolutions of the Company (and each relevant Group Company) approving the Transaction and authorising the registration of the Purchaser as the holder of the Sale Shares;

(c) [where applicable:] a shareholders' written resolution (or minutes of a duly convened extraordinary general meeting) waiving all pre-emption rights, rights of first refusal, and other restrictions on transfer;

(d) the statutory books and registers of each Group Company, including the register of members, register of directors, register of charges, and minute books (all duly brought up to date as at the Completion Date), together with the common seal (if any), certificates of incorporation, and any certificates of incorporation on change of name;

(e) letters of resignation (in agreed form) from any directors, company secretaries, or other officers of each Group Company who are Sellers or Connected Persons of Sellers, each acknowledging that they have no outstanding claims against any Group Company;

(f) evidence of repayment or release of all intra-group and Seller-related Debt owed by any Group Company to any Seller, their Connected Persons, or any person that will no longer be part of the Group following Completion;

(g) evidence of release of all Encumbrances over the Sale Shares or any assets of any Group Company that will not be released or discharged at Completion;

(h) the Disclosure Letter, duly executed by the Sellers;

(i) the Escrow Agreement, duly executed by the Sellers' Representative and the Escrow Agent;

(j) [Key Person Employment Agreements, duly executed by each Key Person;]

(k) [Rollover Agreement, duly executed by the relevant Sellers;]

(l) [W&I Insurance Policy, countersigned by the insurer;]

(m) [Non-Compete Agreements, duly executed by each Seller who is a Key Person or a founder;]

(n) an updated cap table certified as complete and accurate as at the Completion Date; and

(o) any other documents reasonably requested by the Purchaser at least [3] Business Days prior to the Completion Date.

### 5.3 Purchaser's Obligations at Completion

At Completion, the Purchaser shall:

(a) pay the Completion Payment to the Sellers in the proportions set out in Schedule 1A, by electronic funds transfer to the bank accounts notified pursuant to Clause 3.2;

(b) pay the Escrow Amount to the Escrow Account;

(c) [issue the Consideration Shares to the relevant Sellers;]

(d) deliver the Escrow Agreement, duly executed by the Purchaser;

(e) [deliver the Lock-Up Deed, duly executed by the Purchaser (or its parent);] and

(f) deliver certified copies of the board resolutions of the Purchaser authorising execution of this Agreement and all documents to be delivered at Completion.

### 5.4 Simultaneous Actions
